assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: OneSpace Games portal decorative photograph-like artwork, landscape 3:2, intended for small 230px-tall cards. Primary request: A treasured personal game collection: several neat rows of generic unbranded game cases in a walnut cabinet, one well-used handheld console and a controller on a small shelf. Each case has a different abstract colored illustration, with no words. Collection is the unmistakable main subject. Style: cinematic photorealistic architectural still life, warm amber practical light with restrained blue dusk fill, premium walnut and dark charcoal materials, believable texture, cohesive luxury gaming-space family. Composition: one clear semantic focal subject in the central upper two-thirds, readable at thumbnail size and when center-cropped to a square; bottom 20% dark and uncluttered for an HTML caption later. No people, no readable text, no logos, no brands, no interface overlays, no baked-in captions, no watermark. This must be an original distinct composition, not a crop of a previous gaming-room image.
